title: Sparse bounds for maximal rough singular integrals
summary: Let $Ω\in L^1(S^{d-1})$ have vanishing average, and let $T_Ω^\ast$ be the maximal truncation of the associated rough homogeneous singular integral. We prove quantitative sparse bounds for $T_Ω^\ast$. If $Ω\in L^\infty(S^{d-1})$, then, for every $1<p<\infty$, \[ \|T_Ω^\ast\|_{(1,p)\text{-}\mathrm{sparse}} \lesssim_d p'\|Ω\|_{L^\infty(S^{d-1})}. \] For unbounded angular kernels, if $1<q<\infty$ and $Ω\in L^{q,1}\log L(S^{d-1})$, then the same estimate holds for $q'\leq p<\infty$, with the right-hand side replaced by \[ C_{d,q}p' \|Ω\|_{L^{q,1}\log L(S^{d-1})}. \] These estimates retain a…
